threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Inventory are stretching year on year.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Price movements can impact margins due to timing differences between input cost increases and price variation clause adjustments.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "These movements can impact margins, especially where there is a timing difference between increase in input costs and the corresponding adjustment under the price variation clause." (concall transcript - 2026-10-01)
